title: A small exam-tutor example
description: Ten authored questions, ready to try. Follow the full pipeline on an illustrative Hindi-medium tutoring deployment.
deployment: An illustrative Hindi-medium secondary-school exam tutor in India. Learners practise school-level mathematics, science, and Indian civics with written questions and multiple-choice answers. Success means identifying the correct answer and explaining it in Hindi. This authored example is for demonstrating the pipeline, not a validated exam syllabus or original-study benchmark.
source_label: Illustrative example: authored questions and assessment; not MMLU or original-study evidence.

assessment.source: Illustrative assessment authored for this website demo, not a finding from the original study.

input_ontology.justification: Illustrative hypothesis: mathematics, science, and Indian civics serve the stated tutoring tasks; foreign law may fall outside them.

input_content.justification: Illustrative hypothesis: some scenarios explicitly fit Indian learners, some are region-neutral, and others assume foreign context.

input_form.justification: Example assessment: questions are text-only; most are English even though the deployment requests Hindi.

output_ontology.justification: Illustrative hypothesis: answer conventions may depend on an unstated jurisdiction or date format.

output_content.justification: Illustrative hypothesis: a reference answer can be contested where the question leaves a required convention unstated. Foreign subject matter alone does not make an answer incorrect.

output_form.justification: Example assessment: answer letters do not assess the Hindi explanation required by the deployment.

elicitation_summary: Illustrative requirements: Hindi-medium secondary learners in India; mathematics, science and Indian civics; textual questions; correct multiple-choice answers with Hindi explanations. No official syllabus coverage claim is made.
dataset_analysis_report: Ten authored text multiple-choice items with explicit answer options and reference letters. This fixture demonstrates regional relevance and convention ambiguity; it is not a representative benchmark sample. Item features record a human-authored topic only, not model predictions. No media are included.

items.content:
Which gas do plants absorb during photosynthesis?
A. Oxygen
B. Carbon dioxide
C. Nitrogen
D. Helium

Which institution makes laws at the national level in India?
A. Parliament
B. A district court
C. A municipal library
D. A public university

एक आयत की लंबाई 8 सेमी और चौड़ाई 3 सेमी है। उसका क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
A. 11 वर्ग सेमी
B. 22 वर्ग सेमी
C. 24 वर्ग सेमी
D. 48 वर्ग सेमी

At standard atmospheric pressure, at what temperature does pure water freeze?
A. 0 °C
B. 10 °C
C. 50 °C
D. 100 °C

Under the United States Constitution, how many senators represent each state?
A. One
B. Two
C. Three
D. Four

What is the legal minimum age to vote in national elections? No country is specified.
A. 16
B. 18
C. 21
D. 25

A notebook costs ₹40. What is the cost of three notebooks?
A. ₹80
B. ₹100
C. ₹120
D. ₹140

Which organ pumps blood through the human body?
A. Liver
B. Heart
C. Stomach
D. Kidney

Which date does 03/04/2025 represent? No date convention is specified.
A. March 4, 2025
B. April 3, 2025
C. March 5, 2024
D. April 5, 2023
